name: Soulbound Lantern Oil
summary: A flask of oil that burns with a light only the dead can resist.
description: Priests keep it in locked cabinets. It stays lit in the rain.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can pour this oil on a weapon or on the ground within 5 feet. For 1 hour, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 Radiant damage to Undead on a hit, or the ground sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Undead there take 2d6 Radiant damage at the start of their turns. The oil is consumed.
